g.text: PX4 execution loops: who owns each Run()?

text.tspan: One card = one OS execution context. Nested boxes = ordinary work items, NOT extra threads.
Single-estimator example; control-side worker E is included. This is not the full firmware thread count.
NuttX schedules these contexts and provides interrupts, SPI/UART, semaphores and timers.
PX4 wq:* ≠ NuttX HPWORK / LPWORK. Flat build: one shared address space.

g.text: FAST CONTROL DATA PATH — E is the same worker throughout, not three threads

text.tspan: CONTAINMENT shows ownership; no scheduler-to-every-module wires are needed. Cards do not prescribe dispatch order.
C = wq:nav_and_controllers. A/B/C/D names match the sensor-to-EKF map and sequence view.
uORB retains data and notifies subscribers; it is not another card or execution loop. Teal links above are data flow only.
